name: property-matrix
description: Connect to your Property Matrix account to find property management records and perform authorized maintenance, leasing, and accounting actions.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Property Matrix account to find and work with property management records from ChatGPT. Look up accessible companies, properties, units, tenants, leases, vendors, maintenance requests, bills, and invoices. Use the available tools to create or update supported records when you authorize the action. Requires a Property Matrix manager account with API access. Available records and actions depend on the connected account, granted OAuth scopes, and your existing Property Matrix permissions.
defaultPrompt: Show me the properties and units I can access.
Find open maintenance requests for my properties.
List outstanding bills for my properties.
